beliefs.instruction: Prioritize using SVGMobject with provided asset file paths over manual construction using basic primitives (Circle, Square, Line) to ensure professional visual fidelity and reduce the computational overhead associated with complex VGroups, particularly during transformations.

scope.problem_description: Manual construction of complex objects using primitives leads to lower visual quality and potential render performance issues.
context_conditions: Asset paths are present in animation descriptions

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates share the mechanism that SVGs provide superior fidelity and performance compared to primitive-based VGroups.

beliefs.instruction: When loading external SVG assets, wrap the instantiation in a try-except block to provide a procedural fallback using Manim primitives (e.g., Circle, Square) if the file is missing or the path is corrupt. This ensures the render completes even if asset dependencies fail.

scope.problem_description: Render failures occur when specific asset paths provided in the storyboard cannot be found or loaded.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates describe the strategy of providing primitive fallbacks for missing SVG assets to prevent pipeline termination.

beliefs.instruction: During iterative turns (Turn 2+), proactively check the updated storyboard for new asset references tagged as [Asset: ...]. Every newly referenced asset must be loaded and integrated into the scene code, even if it was not in the original plan.

scope.problem_description: Coder fails to integrate high-fidelity assets added to the storyboard during later refinement turns.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Standalone principle ensuring that reactively added assets are incorporated in later turns.

beliefs.instruction: Implement a two-column visual architecture: dedicate the far-left column (Column 1) to textual lecture lines and the remaining workspace (Columns 2-6) to animations. Constrain lecture lines to a maximum of 10 words each to minimize cognitive load and prevent text from crowding the workspace.

scope.problem_description: Inconsistent layouts or long text lines cause high cognitive load and poor layout scores.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: The two-column layout and the word limit on lecture lines function as a unified mechanism for cognitive load reduction.

beliefs.instruction: Maintain clear vertical clearance from the top-aligned scene title by starting primary geometry in Row B or C. Explicitly anchor the title to Row A (A1-A6) using 'place_in_area' and arrange any header indicators (e.g., counters) in consecutive cells without gaps.

scope.problem_description: Mobjects, labels, or indicators overlap with the persistent scene title or appear disjointed.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates all strategies related to grid-based vertical title clearance and top-row indicator management.

beliefs.instruction: Maintain a minimum 1-column horizontal buffer (favoring columns 3-6 for primary foci) between the sidebar lecture text and the animation workspace. This prevents visual crowding, especially when animations utilize complex VGroups or large assets.

scope.problem_description: Animation objects appear cramped against or overlap the lecture text sidebar.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates address the need for a horizontal buffer to separate text and animation zones.

beliefs.instruction: Avoid placing focal mobjects or radial effects (e.g., pulses, spotlights) in Row F, Column 6, or corner coordinates (A1, A6, F1, F6). Anchor them at least one cell inward to prevent clipping by the frame edge or obstruction by playback UI.

scope.problem_description: Focal mobjects are obscured by video UI or clipped by the render frame boundary.
context_conditions: Mobjects have non-zero radius or are placed at grid extremities

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Groups strategies for protecting the render margin from clipping and UI interference at grid boundaries.

beliefs.instruction: Anchor focal mobjects and their corresponding labels in immediate proximity (strictly within 1 grid unit) using adjacent grid cells or shared coordinates to reinforce conceptual association and logical containment.

scope.problem_description: Labels or sub-components appear floating or disconnected from the objects they describe.
context_conditions: Labels are paired with physical or geometric mobjects

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates multiple strategies for reinforcing logical links through spatial proximity and shared grid anchors.

beliefs.instruction: Facilitate direct visual mapping between paired entities (e.g., foci, dual spheres, input/output) by aligning them along a shared horizontal or vertical grid axis or symmetrical grid points (e.g., columns 2 and 5).

scope.problem_description: Staggered or asymmetric placement of related mobjects makes comparisons or logical flows harder to perceive.
context_conditions: Scene involves comparison or symmetrical geometric features

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Combines strategies for alignment-based visual mapping across different geometric and procedural contexts.

beliefs.instruction: Identify the bounding area of primary visualizations (e.g., a 1D signal or 2D plot) and reserve a distinct 1-row or 1-column horizontal/vertical gap for secondary annotations, status labels, or adjacent datasets to prevent visual clutter.

scope.problem_description: Secondary labels or adjacent visualizations overlap with primary mobjects.
context_conditions: Complex visualizations (axes, large lists, side-by-side charts) are present

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Groups strategies for bounding area identification and whitespace reservation between adjacent or overlapping elements.

beliefs.instruction: For focal elements requiring significant screen real estate (e.g., long formulas, abstract paths, global summaries, or primary models), utilize 'place_in_area' spanning 3-6 grid columns/rows rather than a single point to prevent cramping and maintain legible scale.

scope.problem_description: Key mobjects appear too small, horizontally cramped, or lack the scale necessary to signify their conceptual importance.
context_conditions: Mobject width exceeds one grid cell width

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates area-based expansion strategies for different mobject types to solve the same problem of 'cramping'.

beliefs.instruction: Apply differential scaling to emphasize mathematical hierarchies or magnitude differences. Assign higher scale factors (e.g., 1.2x-1.3x) to Results compared to Inputs, and distinct factors (e.g., 1.5x vs 0.7x) to objects representing contrasting physical properties like mass.

scope.problem_description: Inputs, results, or physical entities with magnitude differences look identical on screen, hindering intuition.
context_conditions: Topic involves ratios or relative scales

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates use scaling as a visual metaphor for hierarchy and magnitude.

beliefs.instruction: In scenes with high visual density or multi-row layouts, constrain the scale_factor of primary visualizations (e.g., Axes, NumberPlane) to 0.6-0.8 and restrict long text labels to a single grid row to provide a buffer for labels and prevent clipping.

scope.problem_description: Primary visualizations occupy too much space, displacing labels and causing overlap.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates strategies for scaling down and row-constraining elements to preserve workspace margins.

beliefs.instruction: For geometric proofs involving movement, use 'ValueTracker' linked to an 'updater' function (e.g., using np.arctan2 for rotation or updating coordinates directly) for all dependent geometry. This ensures mathematical relationships like tangency are maintained continuously.

scope.problem_description: Animated transitions look mathematically inconsistent (e.g., lines detaching from points or sliding sideways).
context_conditions: Animating locus properties or oriented assets along curves

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates address the mechanism of using trackers/updaters for continuous mathematical consistency.

beliefs.instruction: Provide satisfying visual payoffs for abstract concepts by animating high-velocity transitions (e.g., chaos to order), zooming into limit points, or moving terminal results to a clean central area after simulation interaction completes.

scope.problem_description: Abstract concepts lack a clear visual conclusion or results overlap with residual simulation objects.
context_conditions: Topic involves convergence, limits, or sequential transitions

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Combines strategies for enhancing the 'climax' or conclusion of an educational animation sequence.

beliefs.instruction: Manage educational pacing by designating Hook and Reveal sections as 'key sections' requiring 5+ animations. Maintain a strict one-to-one count between storyboard lecture lines and animation steps to ensure audio-visual synchronization.

scope.problem_description: Mismatches between line count and animation count lead to poor pacing or insufficient visual scaffolding.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates strategies related to structural pacing and synchronization of text and visuals.

beliefs.instruction: Structure topics exploring complex physical or abstract systems (e.g., Fourier, p-adic numbers, Turbulence) using a narrative scaffold: 1. Baseline Analogy, 2. Prerequisite Parameter, 3. The Big Idea/Mechanism, 4. Mathematical Derivation/Law, 5. Case Study/Paradox, and 6. Global Impact/Synthesis.

scope.problem_description: Complex topics feel disjointed or overwhelm the learner without a scaffolded bridge from intuition to abstraction.
context_conditions: Topic involves physical constants, alternative metrics, or signal processing

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates narrative-level scaffolds for highly complex systems across multiple domains.

beliefs.instruction: Structure topics involving structural or algebraic-geometric transformations (e.g., Change of Basis, Duality, Cramer's Rule) using a 5-6 part scaffold: 1. Hook (The Bridge), 2. Prerequisite Anatomy, 3. Core Visual Transformation, 4. Formal Visual Derivation, and 5. Application/Generalization.

scope.problem_description: Transformation concepts feel abstract or disjointed without a clear progression from primitives to unified mental maps.
context_conditions: Topic involves topology, linear algebra, or unified inverse operations

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates scaffolding strategies specific to mathematical transformations and mappings.

beliefs.instruction: Ground abstract parameters or mappings in intuitive archetypes by using character-driven analogies (e.g., Alice/Bob as navigators), biological metaphors (e.g., Ant vs Squirrel), interactive UI metaphors (e.g., 'volume sliders'), or standard relational analogies (e.g., King/Queen).

scope.problem_description: Abstract behaviors (like semantic distance or convergence) are difficult to grasp without physical grounding.
context_conditions: Topic involves vector space, variable coefficients, or alternative systems

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates strategies for grounding abstract logic in intuitive physical or character-driven metaphors.

beliefs.instruction: To ensure code robustness across Manim environments, prioritize using hexadecimal strings for colors (e.g., '#00FFFF') and explicitly wrap these in 'ManimColor' objects when performing color interpolation to avoid AttributeErrors.

scope.problem_description: Render failures occur due to NameErrors on shorthand constants or TypeErrors during color interpolation.
context_conditions: Use of interpolate_color or color constants

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates address the mechanism of using robust color representations (hex/ManimColor) to prevent environment-specific render crashes.

beliefs.instruction: Prioritize standard Manim CE class names and parameters. Specifically, use 'Indicate' (not 'Indication'), 'Star' with 'n' (not 'n_outer'), 'set_opacity(0)' instead of 'hide()' for Axes, and 'apply_matrix' for shear transformations.

scope.problem_description: Render failures occur due to NameErrors or AttributeErrors on non-existent or deprecated Manim methods/classes.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates specific Manim CE naming and API attribute precautions to prevent common render-time errors.

beliefs.instruction: Correctly implement Manim API signatures for multi-step or complex mobjects: avoid passing 'inner_radius' to Sector, use 'buffer_factor' for Circle.surround, use 'TangentLine' class (not keyword arg), and use 'Succession' for sequential animations.

scope.problem_description: TypeError or AttributeError occurs when passing redundant or invalid keyword arguments to Manim API methods.
context_conditions: Using Sector, TangentLine, or animation chaining

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates precautions for correctly handling method signatures and keyword arguments in the Manim API.

beliefs.instruction: Apply color and attribute methods to the correct parent mobject type. Use 'set_color_by_tex' on 'MathTex' objects (not sub-elements or Text) and use the 't2c' parameter or manual indexing for coloring 'Text' mobjects.

scope.problem_description: TypeError occurs when trying to apply MathTex-specific color methods to sub-elements or Text objects.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Groups strategies for correctly targeting sub-elements and appropriate class methods for color modification.

beliefs.instruction: Prevent render timeouts and LaTeX stability issues by consolidating multi-part formulas into single MathTex mobjects, setting 'config.no_latex_cleanup = True', and replacing heavy per-frame updaters with efficient direct coordinate manipulation.

scope.problem_description: Computational overhead or LaTeX race conditions cause render failures or timeouts.
context_conditions: High visual density or multi-turn automated pipeline

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates render performance and stability strategies into a single preventative instruction.

beliefs.instruction: Follow grid and pipeline execution protocols: use 1-indexed references for grid coordinates, use 'angle_of_vector' for raw grid array subtraction, and wrap all mobjects in Animation classes (e.g. FadeIn) when calling 'self.play'.

scope.problem_description: KeyErrors, AttributeErrors, or TypeErrors occur due to incorrect indexing or passing raw mobjects to play().

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates low-level coding precautions for the grid system and core Scene methods.

beliefs.instruction: The Coder must use computational libraries (e.g., numpy) to calculate derived mathematical constants and matrices in the script, and the ScriptWriter must mathematically verify all discrete element counts (V, E, F) before turn 1 to ensure credibility.

scope.problem_description: Factual or calculation errors in mathematical examples undermine educational authority.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates address the mechanism of ensuring mathematical accuracy via verification and computation.

beliefs.instruction: Maintain strict visual identity and naming consistency for logical entities across all sections. Use identical SVG assets, unified color palettes, and consistent variable names (e.g. 'y' not 'h') throughout the run to avoid learner confusion.

scope.problem_description: Inconsistent visual assets, colors, or naming aliases degrade professional polish and increase cognitive load.
context_conditions: Same logical entities/variables appear in multiple sections

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates principles for ensuring global visual and terminological consistency across multi-part MAS productions.

beliefs.instruction: If the scale of a specific component in a repeated architecture (e.g., a weight matrix box) is adjusted for visibility, apply identical scaling to all peer components of that type within the scene to maintain symmetry.

scope.problem_description: Asymmetrical scaling of identical architectural components leads to an unbalanced aesthetic.
context_conditions: Multiple instances of a component type
Manual scaling adjustment is requested for one instance

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Standalone principle for maintaining symmetry in multi-component architectural visualizations.

beliefs.instruction: Position isolated labels or markers at least one cell inward from the grid extremities (Favor B2 or E5 over A1 or F6) to ensure visual padding and prevent overlap with high-arcing animation paths that pass through the central workspace.

scope.problem_description: Labels look cramped at the edge of the frame or collide with high-arc trajectories.
context_conditions: Use of path_arc or isolated markers

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates use inward grid anchors as a strategy for margin protection and trajectory clearance.

beliefs.instruction: Optimize professional readability on digital displays by defaulting to sans-serif fonts, applying a 0.8 scale_factor for small indicators like character bits, and maximizing grid footprint for fine high-frequency artifacts.

scope.problem_description: Choice of fonts or undersized artifacts degrades readability on digital screens.
context_conditions: Fine mathematical details or bits are visualized

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates typography and high-detail scaling strategies to ensure digital legibility.

beliefs.instruction: For short Text or MathTex mobjects where aspect ratio is critical, prioritize 'place_at_grid' with an explicit 'scale_factor' over 'place_in_area'. For complex effects, instantiate MathTex with a list of strings to enable precise indexing.

scope.problem_description: Small mobjects appear stretched during area-fitting or lack targeted highlight control.
context_conditions: Precise scaling or variable highlighting required

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Groups strategies for precise control over text/formula appearance and internal animation.

beliefs.instruction: Establish a predictable vertical flow: use Row A for path labels, Rows B-E for animations, and Row F for results. Arrange stages in vertical 'ladders' to map dimensional growth and ensure initial objects are high for downward flows.

scope.problem_description: Horizontal or staggered placement makes procedural or dimensional growth difficult to follow.
context_conditions: Procedural flow is top-to-bottom or involves dimension-building

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Consolidates strategies for mapping chronological and dimensional growth to the grid's Y-axis.

beliefs.instruction: In discrete counting visualizations (e.g. Moser's Circle), use non-uniform angular spacing to prevent degeneracies and implement conditional icon scaling (e.g. scale down if quantity > 4) to ensure results remain within grid boundaries.

scope.problem_description: Degeneracies or overflowing icon groups cause inaccurate visual counts or cluttered tables.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both candidates optimize parameters (angles/scaling) for visual accuracy in discrete element counting.

beliefs.instruction: Position descriptive labels in distinct, non-overlapping grid areas relative to their targets. Centered labels on segments require area spans, and labels for formulas or coordinate systems should be shifted to prevent intersection with axis lines.

scope.problem_description: Labels overlap with axis lines or associated formulas, impairing readability.
context_conditions: Coordinate plane or highlighted segments present

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Groups strategies for precise, collision-free placement of descriptive labels relative to their features.

beliefs.instruction: In factual retrieval sequences, ensure the string used for the 'Value' label retrieved from the model is identical to the target prediction text displayed at the end of the sequence to avoid learner confusion.

scope.problem_description: The retrieved fact label does not match the final predicted text output.
context_conditions: Topic involves associative memory or retrieval

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Standalone principle for pedagogical consistency in retrieval sequences.

beliefs.instruction: When visualizing volume or size ratios that become extreme in hyperspace, apply differential scaling—scaling the container up (2.0x+) and the interior object down (0.1x)—to emphasize the mathematical divergence.

scope.problem_description: Mathematically accurate scaling fails to convey vanishing effects in high dimensions clearly on screen.
context_conditions: Topic involves volume divergence in high dimensions

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Niche but effective strategy for high-dimensional visual intuition.

beliefs.instruction: Use the term 'n-ball' when referring to the interior volume of a hypersphere and 'n-sphere' when referring to its surface area to ensure mathematical accuracy and prevent confusion between boundary and interior.

scope.problem_description: Using 'n-sphere' to describe volume is technically imprecise.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Standardizes technical terminology for volume vs surface area in high dimensions.

beliefs.instruction: When overlaying a theoretical distribution curve on empirical data (like histogram bars), ensure both mobjects are positioned using the exact same 'place_in_area' coordinates and 'scale_factor' to guarantee geometric alignment.

scope.problem_description: Overlay curves do not align precisely with data bins, breaking visual logic.
context_conditions: Simultaneous display of statistical curve and histogram

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Ensures precise alignment between empirical data and theoretical overlays.

beliefs.instruction: For scenes concluding with a significant numerical result or mathematical identity, extend the terminal 'self.wait()' to at least 3 seconds to facilitate mental mapping from visual movement to algebraic values.

scope.problem_description: Learners lack time to process numerical results before the video transitions.
context_conditions: MathTex results displayed at scene climax

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Standalone principle regarding terminal wait time for complex results.

beliefs.instruction: Represent conditional probability P(A|B) using the visual metaphor of 'sample space shrinking', fading out irrelevant parts of the universe and scaling the condition (Event B) to fill the workspace.

scope.problem_description: Conditional probability denominators are difficult to grasp without clear visual reduction.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Niche but effective pedagogical metaphor for Bayes/Probability.

beliefs.instruction: Limit the magnitude of 'Transform' scale changes between related sequential symbolic mobjects to a factor of 1.25x or less. Visual jumps larger than this appear jarring and break visual hierarchy.

scope.problem_description: Jarring visual transitions when transforming sequential logical steps.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Establishes a threshold for comfortable visual transformation scaling.

beliefs.instruction: Avoid using whimsical or pop-culture-referencing shapes as placeholder icons in technical educational content; stick to abstract primitives or domain-specific icons to maintain a professional academic tone.

scope.problem_description: Stylistic clashing between professional design and informal placeholders.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Standalone principle regarding academic tone and professionalism.

beliefs.instruction: To implement stable stretching/squashing of an SVGMobject in an updater, store a copy of the object's initial points (mob.points.copy()) and re-apply transformations relative to that original state in each frame to prevent erratic deformation.

scope.problem_description: Compounding transformations in updaters lead to erratic mobject deformation.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Precise state-management strategy for stable Manim updaters.

beliefs.instruction: In high visual complexity scenes, use a 'BackgroundRectangle' with high fill opacity (0.85) behind terminal counts or summary results to provide visual separation from background geometric clutter.

scope.problem_description: Focal text labels are unreadable due to overlapping background geometry.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific UI strategy for legibility in dense scenes.

beliefs.instruction: For physical verification scenes (e.g. Tautochrone), use exact mathematical parameterizations (such as harmonic motion for cycloids) rather than linear or ease-based approximations to ensure the visual proof matches the claim.

scope.problem_description: Approximated animations fail to visually prove the scientific property being explained.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Strategy ensuring rigorous visual evidence for physics topics.

beliefs.instruction: Synchronize the color of lecture line text bullets with the focal color of the mobjects they describe, and use spectrum hex sequences for shifting effects like 'rainbow holograms' to reinforce conceptual links.

scope.problem_description: Lack of visual association between text points and animation objects makes the narrative harder to follow.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Both strategies use color as a tool for visual mapping and intra-scene synchronization.

beliefs.instruction: In multi-step procedural walkthroughs (e.g. 7+ steps), implement intermediate repetitive steps as 'fast-forward' animations with shorter run_times and minimal lecture lines to maintain pacing.

scope.problem_description: Exhaustive walkthroughs of repetitive algorithms become tedious.

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Standalone principle for algorithmic pacing.

beliefs.instruction: Represent rare event paradoxes (e.g. base rate fallacy) using a 10x10 discrete grid of squares, coloring target populations to allow learners to compare true versus false positives directly.

scope.problem_description: Learners struggle to visualize the impact of false positives when base rates are low.
context_conditions: Topic involves Bayes' Theorem or detection paradoxes

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Specific visualization tool for Bayesian pedagogical accuracy.

beliefs.instruction: Structure counter-intuitive problems using a narrative arc: 1. Setup, 2. Seductive Pattern (induction), 3. Great Betrayal (failure), 4. Theoretical Proof, and 5. Conclusion/Generalization.

scope.problem_description: Counter-intuitive topics involving pattern breakdown lack a compelling logical flow.
context_conditions: Topic involves a pattern that fails after initial cases

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Scaffolding narrative arc specifically for counter-intuitive induction.

beliefs.instruction: In scenes featuring 3D volumes or dense object clusters, position descriptive labels strictly outside the projected boundary (using the next available grid row/column) to prevent text from being obscured.

scope.problem_description: Labels become unreadable when placed inside the visual footprint of a dense or volumetric mobject.
context_conditions: Visualizing 3D volumes or dense vector groups

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Standalone strategy for label legibility in 3D/volumetric contexts.

beliefs.instruction: For structural transformations like duality, center the initial primal object in a restricted area (e.g. B3-E5) to provide a spatial buffer for transformed elements that naturally sit outside the original footprint.

scope.problem_description: Transformed objects clip screen edges because the original object occupied the entire workspace.
context_conditions: Topic involves dual or mirrored constructions

beliefs.consolidation_reason: Spatial strategy specifically for dual/mirrored transformation buffers.
